headline: Contested Fronts Stir as Base Lines Shift
war_summary: Since the last edition, the sharpest movement has come in Weathered Expanse, where 58 base events were recorded in 24 hours and nine in the latest two-hour watch. Its ledger now shows five Warden-held bases, one Colonial-held base, and three neutral positions, a marked change from the earlier balance. Linn Mercy remains highly unsettled, with five events in two hours and 36 across the day; it now lists two Warden, seven Colonial, and two neutral bases, while casualty rates for both sides have accelerated. Nevish Line has likewise quickened, reporting nine recent events and 39 in 24 hours, with two Warden, six Colonial, and no neutral bases. Mooring County is quieter than before, though sixteen daily events leave its twelve bases under Warden control. Stonecradle retains eight Colonial and one Warden base after fourteen daily events, but none in the latest six hours. Marban Hollow remains divided at four Warden, three Colonial, and one neutral base, with only three events in the day. Most other sectors report no recent base movement.
